title: Relaying abduction data such as pain levels

tellings.quote: started to receive stuff that indicated that it was um uh abductions.

plain: Between 1990 and 1993, at a site he calls Base 2, a former sergeant named Dan Sherman says the messages he was receiving began to show that they were about abductions, meaning people taken by alien beings, with details such as pain levels passed along. Sherman tells Michels this firsthand, as part of his account of being hired by the NSA to communicate with aliens. If true, it would mean a US intelligence agency was quietly collecting data on abductions.
